Checkpoints (140, 163) preserve data but don't satisfy the completion requirement. Root causes to record: (1) run-B had ZERO extension margin against a hard fleet deadline — never schedule that; (2) the override lifeline required board approval that wasn't pre-obtained — pre-authorize before the window, not during; (3) cross-run lesson from run-A: pre-grant export_metrics so result export isn't a last-minute bottleneck. The team acted within policy throughout; the failure was scheduling margin and authorization lead-time, not execution.
